About Us

EDNEX SDN.BHD.

Established in Johor, Malaysia, EDNEX SDN.BHD. is one of the leading suppliers and distributors of heavy truck parts in Malaysia. We are specialists in new and used parts for major commercial vehicle brands including Volvo, Scania, and Mercedes-Benz.

Our mega warehouse is equipped with strict internal operating procedures to ensure prompt stock availability, convenient storage system and prompt delivery of our products to our customers.

We are also specialised in the supply of engines, gearboxes, axles, chassis components and precision engine parts for the heavy transport industry.

  • Volvo, Scania, Mercedes-Benz & more
  • Complete engines to individual components
  • Nationwide delivery — all 13 states
  • After-sales support & technical consultation
